dedupe_keys.name: modelon energy systems library esl modelica techno economic sizing and operation of hybrid electricity heat and hydrogen systems

description: The Energy Systems Library (ESL) is a commercial Modelica library from Modelon for planning and optimising industrial to utility-scale energy systems covering electricity, heat and hydrogen; it appears in the Modelica Association's library index. Contents: pre-configured models and an interface for boundary conditions (reference costs, weather data, market price curves) that support techno-economic optimisation of the production, storage and consumption, including purchase and sale, of electricity, heat, water, CO2, hydrogen and other fuels. Users can optimise component sizes and control strategy together, apply constraints such as a maximum CO2 budget or minimum hydrogen fuel share, compute capital and operating costs, total cost of ownership and load duration curves, and compare market scenarios through an Excel interface. Producer: Modelon. Coverage: generic sites and systems. Format and access: available exclusively in Modelon Impact with a drag-and-drop interface; demonstrations on request. Licence: commercial Modelon licence. Caveats: needs a paid Modelon Impact licence; results rest on user price and weather inputs. Simulation uses: sizing solar, battery and hydrogen storage for industrial sites, decarbonisation investment planning, and operating strategy studies for hybrid energy hubs. Related records: model-modelon-thermal-power-library-plant-and-district-heating-dynamics and model-multienergysystem-modelica-library.
